verdict.rationale: Bench is a bookkeeping, tax and banking service that pairs software with human bookkeepers, not an AI agent or tool-hosting platform. Its only AI feature is a narrow transaction-categorization assistant, so acting as an MCP client is outside this product's category. Nothing in the evidence shows it can connect to or consume external MCP tools.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
